cases.surface: For training, suppose a fictional employee keeps reopening the same portal without any personal evidence from me.
Bài tập lớp: giả sử một applicant hư cấu liên tục kiểm tra portal. Đây không phải tình huống của tôi.
Workshop example only: an invented manager delays a decision. It is not my situation.
No single moment identifies what I did next, so one actual behaviour from me linked to one concrete event is still missing.
Will the final decision resolve positively within the coming weeks?
I waited for the concrete facts and then acted at a normal pace instead of rushing.
What are they secretly thinking about me right now?
